devices.name: Yobiiq - EM2101 - 1 Phase Energy Meter
devices.description: The YOBIIQ iQ Electricity EM2101 is a direct connected 1 Phase Energy Meter with built-in relay for controlling output.

devices.name: Yobiiq - EM4301-CT - 3 Phase Energy Meter
devices.description: The YOBIIQ iQ Electricity EM4301-CT is a current transformer operated, 3 Phase Energy Meter.

devices.name: Yobiiq - EM4301 - 3 Phase Energy Meter
devices.description: The YOBIIQ iQ Electricity EM4301 is a direct connected, 3 Phase Energy Meter for loads up to 100A.

devices.name: Yobiiq - iQ DSMR - Dutch Smart Meter Reader
devices.description: The YOBIIQ iQ DSMR (P1) is a member of our Smart Environment Modules family and Smart metering device, DSMR Relay port, a secondary port is available to forward the DSMR signals to third party devices like solar converters or curtailment node. It contains 2 digital inputs for pulse readers from other energy sources and a optional digital output to control based on consumption.

devices.name: Yobiiq - iQ Opentherm - LoRaWAN Boiler Controller
devices.description: The YOBIIQ iQ Opentherm Gateway Boiler Controller, part of our Smart Environmental Control Modules, seamlessly integrates practical usability with advanced LoRaWAN technology. Consequently, this Opentherm Controller facilitates smart boiler controls, making it a key component of Smart Boiler Solutions. By reading real-time data from your connected thermostat and boiler, it allows you to either monitor or actively manage your boiler’s operation. As a result, it becomes an essential element of Smart Building Solutions, enhancing overall Environmental Control.

devices.name: Yobiiq - RM200 - Digital Output Relay Module
devices.description: The YOBIIQ RM200 makes it possible to control digital outputs by utilizing remote automation, We have developed the iQ Digital Controller with 2 fully isolated, seperate relays. Each relay is capable of switching up to a 10A 230V AC. Using the override buttons on the device you are able to control the relay output regardless of the network connection.
